_what: EMPTY since 2026-10-13: the 15 metrics served at 108 without a measured contract were measured and are in the corpus. The file stays so a future served-but-unmeasured metric has its place (omega.contract reads it).

source.sameAs: get_metric_construction_hints input metric enum at 104.0.0 and 104.1.0 (battlegrid-manager tests/fixtures/2026-10-08-surface-104.*/tool_definitions.json): identical 171 values, same order

patterns.quote: candle patterns - CANDLE_DOJI (boolean), CANDLE_PIN (lower_wick / upper_wick / none), CANDLE_ENGULFING (bullish / bearish / none), BAR_CONTAINMENT (inside / outside / none) ... The patterns, gaps and runs compose value only, and none of the twelve is ranked.
patterns.status: DESCRIPTION, not measured - recorded, not modelled

gaps.quote: gaps - GAP and GAP_RANGE_CLEAR (up / down / none) and GAP_PCT, the signed % from the prior close to the open
gaps.status: DESCRIPTION, not measured - recorded, not modelled

runs.quote: run lengths - CLOSE_RUN and CANDLE_RUN, consecutive bars one way, capped at +/-20
runs.status: DESCRIPTION, not measured - recorded, not modelled

sources.quote: price sources - HL2, HLC3, OHLC4, price facts that take every transform a close takes
sources.status: DESCRIPTION, not measured - recorded, not modelled

swingLevels.quote: SWING_FRACTAL_HIGH and SWING_FRACTAL_LOW ... They are candle price levels: every transform a candle level takes, levelInteraction included, and they rank across the board as dist_fractalHi / dist_fractalLo.
swingLevels.status: DESCRIPTION, not measured - recorded, not modelled

swingLabel.quote: SWING_FRACTAL_LABEL ... HH / LH for a high, HL / LL for a low, none when no comparable pair is in reach. A held state, value-only
swingLabel.status: DESCRIPTION, not measured - recorded, not modelled
